proof_body:
by
  intro A D β z hz
  have hn : Complex.normSq z ≠ 0 := (Complex.normSq_pos.mpr hz).ne'
  have e1 : ‖z⁻¹‖ ^ 2 = (Complex.normSq z)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_inv]
  have e2 : (β * z⁻¹).re = ((starRingEnd ℂ) β * z).re / Complex.normSq z := by
    rw [Complex.inv_def]
    simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
    field_simp
  rw [e1, e2, Complex.sq_norm]
  constructor
  · intro h
    field_simp
    linarith
  · intro h
    field_simp at h
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (A D : ℝ) (β z : ℂ), z ≠ 0 → (A * ‖z‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ((starRingEnd ℂ) β * z).re + D = 0 ↔ D * ‖z⁻¹‖ ^ 2 + 2 * (β * z⁻¹).re + A = 0)
